newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks track FTSE in quiet London trade.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks track FTSE in quiet London trade.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks in London failed to match their earlier strong performance in Hong Kong on Monday and tracked the UK's FTSE 100 in a day of relatively quiet and uneventful trading, traders said.

While the Hang Seng index registered its biggest gain since March, closing up 227.567 points at 12,133.07, the Hang Seng London Reference Index was up a modest 44.93 points at 12,178.00. The UK's FTSE was up 11.1 points at 4,035.9.
"There was very little follow-through from Hong Kong," said one trader. "All eyes are on bonds and Wall St to see where we go from here."

Traders said there were no real features in London trading. In Hong Kong the market rose strongly, fired by investor confidence and hopes that interest rates would be stable after Friday's weaker-than-expected U.S jobs data for September.
